messages:
anna: Drafted release notes v1.7.3 with Adaptive routing GA + embedding streaming opt-in. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2470
diego: quick pass  hero/ bullets look good. small snag: changelog index -> sections anchors jump to top on preview. Repro in Chrome.
leah: yeah saw that too. linkcheck on preview shows missing anchors for #adaptive-routing and #embedding-streaming.
anna: hmm. we recently bumped markdown renderer; slug generation likely changed. i'll add a Known issue note to the draft: 'Changelog anchors may be inconsistent on preview due to heading id normalization; workaround: use browser find or direct permalink. Fix deploying.'
diego: also the Python SDK snippet still uses create_embedding(model='x')  client now expects model_id and returns embeddings[]. i'll push a snippet patch to the branch.
leah: for anchors i propose adding a small build slugifier (NFKD ascii-fold) and a redirect table mapping legacy->new anchors so published links don't break. cheap and reversible.
anna: sounds good. can you open a tiny PR for slugify + _redirects and tag me? i'll keep the known-issue note with an ETA (~30-90m) until redirects land.
docs-bot: Preview build: https://deploy-preview-2470--docs.redwood.com  status: linkcheck FAILED (2 broken anchors)
docs-bot: ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #adaptive-routing
docs-bot: ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #embedding-streaming
diego: opened PR 2471: slugify shim + redirects. snippet patch is in PR2470 branch.
leah: reviewed 2471  redirects look right, slugify script matches our ascii-fold rules. leaving small comment on tests.
anna: merged PR2470 (snippets) into main. will merge 2471 once CI green. left a short Developer notes section in the release draft listing the SDK changes and migration tips for permalinks.
docs-bot: PR2471 merged. Redeploy preview: linkcheck PASS for anchors.
anna: removed Known issue from draft and updated ETA note to 'resolved'. finalizing banner copy and legal review. thanks team!
leah: quick follow-up: added a short migration snippet under Developer notes showing a curl redirect example for integrators with old permalinks.
diego: all good from my side. closing thread unless linkcheck reappears on prod.
